messages:
Sara: incident-bot alerted: sudden p95/p99 spike for hosted-us-west, GPU-backed queues growing fast. Putting this in #incidents.
incident-bot: ALERT: hosted-us-west queue_length 1.3k -> severity=high. Paging oncall.
Sara: checking provisioner api calls now — seeing repeated failures to create instances.
raj: digging into provisioner logs: `grep -i quota /var/log/provisioner/*.log` shows `QuotaExceeded: gpu quota 0/region` for the last 9 attempts. Autoscaler retried 6 times.
miguel: looks like a traffic storm from a single API key, huge context lengths. Could be leaked staging creds or a load test. Need top callers.
lee: running a quick aggregation on request logs: `SELECT api_key, count(*) as reqs, sum(tokens) FROM requests WHERE ts > now()-10m GROUP BY api_key ORDER BY sum_tokens DESC LIMIT 5` -> top key acct_XT92 responsible for ~65% of tokens.
amanda (CS): I'm pulling account details for acct_XT92. On it — pinging account owner and support to check if this is expected.
ops-oncall: mitigation plan options: 1) emergency quota request (may be slow). 2) apply per-key emergency rate limit at gateway. 3) cancel long queued work for offending key. 4) reroute batch-like traffic cross-region or to CPU fallback nodes. 5) serve degraded/quantized model for non-SLAs.
raj: deployed a gateway rule to cap acct_XT92 to 80 rps soft-limit. Command: `gatewayctl set-rate --key=acct_XT92 --rps=80 --reason="emergency"` — applied.
Sara: immediate effect: queue growth rate reduced. p95 improving from 980ms to ~220ms, but p99 still elevated due to already in-flight long requests.
miguel: initiating queue cleanup: cancel queued requests >45s from acct_XT92 to free slots. `POST /admin/queues/cancel?key=acct_XT92&older_than=45s` -> 378 canceled, responses will return 429 with advice header.
lee: enabling routing fallback: for any request that would hit model=redwood-large and tenant_tier==free and backlog>400 route to redwood-medium-quant. Updated rule and pushing.
ops-oncall: ensure we don't silently downgrade paid tiers. Add exception for paid/enterprise tiers.
infra-bot: Deploy started: routing-fallback-1745678912 by lee. CI ok.
infra-bot: Deploy finished: routing-fallback-1745678912. Rules active in us-west and us-east.
Sara: contacting affected customers with a templated notice: "Temporary throttling applied due to excessive usage. If you're seeing 429s, rotate keys and contact support." Amanda leading comms.
amanda (CS): Confirmed acct_XT92 is a staging key not tied to a billable account. Asking customer contacts to revoke and rotate.
raj: opened cloud support case #CASE-80222 and requested emergency quota bump. Cloud responded they can allow a temporary 12-GPU soft increase pending billing verification. I submitted billing artifacts.
miguel: while we wait, starting siphon job to move batch/large-ctx requests to eu-west spare pool: `siphonctl start --from=us-west --to=eu-west --filter="batch||large_ctx" --max=200rps` -> job accepted.
lee: also enabling a temporary cpu-fallback pool for short-running low-cost requests to reduce GPU load: `provisioner --create cpu-fallback --count=10` (uses existing spare hosts).
ops-oncall: cross-region routing will impact latency ~200-400ms for those requests; ensure we mark them as async in headers.
Sara: p95 now ~160ms, p99 ~1.18s, backlog ~140. Getting better. Keeping pager open until stable for 60 minutes.
incident-bot: Incident created INC-1745678910. Assigned: raj (lead), Sara (customer comms), lee (routing), miguel (queue ops). Status: mitigation_in_progress.
sales-ps: FYI, customer C reported degraded batch job; flagging potential SLA blip. Notifying legal and AMs.
raj: cloud temporarily allowed +10 GPUs, provisioner successfully created 9 nodes and they joined the cluster: `node-join: gpu-a1 ready, gpu-a2 ready, ...`
Sara: backlog down to ~30, p95 ~90ms, p99 ~320ms. Stabilized. We'll keep this incident in monitoring for 2 hours and then run a blameless postmortem.
miguel: saved canceled request ids and error traces to incident doc for reproducibility. Also collecting CPU/GPU utilization graphs for the timeline.
lee: follow-ups being added to incident doc: 1) automated alert for repeated quota_denied errors (threshold 3/min). 2) build automated per-key emergency throttle tied to high-token-rate heuristics. 3) add staging-key detection and living runbook for leaked credentials. 4) document cross-region siphon and CPU-fallback runbooks.
ops-oncall: creating tickets and assigning owners.
incident-bot: INC-1745678910 status -> mitigated; monitoring. Pager closed.
Sara: handing off to post-incident lead. Raj will continue chasing cloud billing confirmation. We'll run a postmortem tomorrow 10:30. Thanks everyone for the quick response. :thumbsup:
raj: will follow up on the quota confirmation and update the incident doc.
amanda (CS): I'll confirm key rotation with affected parties and update customer comms thread.
Sara: TL;DR for postmortem: "Leaked staging API key caused concentrated token-heavy traffic hitting hosted-us-west GPUs -> autoscaler repeatedly failed due to cloud GPU quota -> queue growth and p99 latency spike. Rapid mitigations: emergency per-key rate limit, cancel queued long requests, routing fallback to quantized models and cross-region siphon for batches, temporary CPU-fallback and cloud temporary quota bump. Follow-ups: quota-denied alerting, automated per-key throttles, restrict staging keys, and update runbooks."
